name: Six Senses Laamu
insider_take: This overwater paradise sits in the pristine Laamu Atoll, where you're literally surrounded by one of the Maldives' largest natural lagoons and some of the most untouched coral reefs in the Indian Ocean.
whats_special: Six Senses Laamu is the only resort in the remote Laamu Atoll, accessible only by a scenic 45-minute seaplane journey. The resort features the Maldives' largest overwater spa and is built around sustainability - they even have their own ice cream parlor, chocolate room, and organic garden. The surrounding waters are part of a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, making it a hotspot for marine life including manta rays and whale sharks.
pro_tip: Book the Laamu Water Villa for direct lagoon access and try the complimentary dolphin cruise at sunset - the Laamu Atoll has one of the highest dolphin populations in the Maldives.
dont_miss: The underwater restaurant Subsix, where you can dine 6 meters below sea level surrounded by tropical fish, and the resort's marine biology center where you can participate in coral restoration projects. The neighboring uninhabited islands are perfect for private picnics accessible by the resort's traditional dhoni boats.
pros: Overwater and beachfront villas with direct ocean access
Award-winning spa with holistic wellness programs
Exceptional marine conservation and sustainability initiatives
World-class diving and snorkeling at pristine coral reefs
cons: Remote atoll location requires seaplane transfer
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
